risk_note: RV2 by path (tools/agent). Review-gate tooling only, no money moves (D10-2954 / D10-2976; owner decisions in ops/approvals.yaml ids 194, 201, 206 ①, 207): validate-output.ts judges a finding's scope by its file / line only; an S0 / S1 finding judged out of scope (now, or by an earlier --rewrite of the same file, kept in a side record) is no longer recomputed into a pass: the validator exits 3 and codex-run.sh turns that into its exit 13, which stops the chain; prompt-injection findings and findings on the brief are never moved out. Fault paths (ledger patch 1, #758): on a full disk, a read / write fault or a damaged record the run must not exit 0, must not turn a fail into a pass and must not damage the written review or side record; whether the exit code is 13 is not guaranteed. Round 6 (approval 207): the validator's own write-back of the review and of the side record continues a short write and, when the bytes are not all on disk, throws, keeps the previous file and does not rename; tools/lib/fsx.ts is untouched (FU-FSX-ATOMIC-SHORT-WRITE). Known remainder, S2 of the last review round: the side record is replaced before the review is written back, so a failed write-back after a manual re-validation with a narrower scope leaves a record that no longer matches the review on disk (FU-VALIDATOR-SIDE-RECORD-ORDER). Third-class gate change: merge under ops/approvals.yaml id 16 after the orchestrator checks the diff.

The validator moved 0 findings out of scope in every round (D10-2954). r5 reviewed the uncommitted r6 work tree on 73bd9fc34; the tree then committed is that tree, verified on the test machine (verify:fast exit 0, fast8; rule-test directory and validate-output unit tests green, tests7).
